Reflex Rules ​

Field reference for Reflex, Event, and the matching vocabulary .

Reflex ​

FieldTypeMeaning
idstringRule id
orgId?stringOwning org; matching is scoped to same-org rules
createdBy?stringFires act as this user — their budget and permissions govern the fired run
namestringShort human name; also used as the fired run's title
enabledbooleanThe kill switch
sourcestringEvent family to listen on
typestringEvent type; '*' matches any type within the source
matchMatchNodeBoolean condition tree over the payload (a legacy array = implicit AND)
actionActionSpecWhat to do when it fires
briefstringPrompt/message/URL template. Supports {{payload.x}} and {{actor}}
project?stringRegistry project the fired run is scoped to

Controls ​

FieldEffect
cooldownSec?Minimum seconds between fires
dedupKey?Template rendered per event; a repeated key within a TTL window is skipped
maxFires?Auto-disable after this many total fires
requireApproval?Park the fire for the operator to approve/deny before the action runs

Bookkeeping ​

fireCount?, createdAt, updatedAt, lastFiredAt?, lastRunId?, lastSkippedAt?, lastSkipReason?, lastError?.

Event ​

FieldTypeMeaning
idstringUnique — used for dedup / idempotency
atnumberEpoch ms
sourcestringrun | agent | stripe | github | generic | …
typestringe.g. run.finished, payment_intent.succeeded
actor?stringRun title, sender handle, repo…
payloadRecord<string, unknown>Normalized, matchable fields
raw?unknownThe untouched original, kept for audit / re-parse
runId?stringSet when the event originated inside a run (chaining)
depth?numberChain depth; the bus loop-guard caps it
orgId?stringOwning org

Built-in run events ​

Run transitionEvent type
donerun.finished
errorrun.failed
awaiting_input with a pending approval gaterun.needs_approval

Plain awaiting_input, paused, and cancelled emit no reflex event.

Operators ​

OperatorApplies toNotes
eq / neqanyStrict equality (=== / !==)
gt gte lt ltenumbersBoth sides must be numbers, else false
betweennumbersvalue is [min, max], inclusive
containsstring, arraySubstring for strings; membership for arrays
startsWith / endsWithstringBoth sides must be strings
matchesstringRegex test. An invalid pattern returns false (fails closed)
matchesIstringCase-insensitive regex
inanyvalue must be an array containing the field
existsanyNot undefined and not null
changedanyDiffers from the last value this reflex saw for this field. First sighting counts as changed

field is a dot-path resolved into the payload (user.plan, amount, from). A path that does not resolve yields undefined, which only exists and changed treat specially.

MatchNode ​

ts
type MatchNode =
  | Condition                 // leaf
  | { all: MatchNode[] }      // AND
  | { any: MatchNode[] }      // OR
  | { not: MatchNode };       // NOT

ActionSpec ​

ActionShapeUse
startRun{ kind: 'startRun' }Open a new run from brief
sendToRun{ kind: 'sendToRun', runId }Send brief into an existing run
notify{ kind: 'notify' }Tell the operator
emitEvent{ kind: 'emitEvent', event: { source, type, actor?, payload? } }Chain another event
callAgent{ kind: 'callAgent', agent }Hand one bounded task to a custom agent
webhookOut{ kind: 'webhookOut', url, method?, headers? }POST/PUT outbound

Console records ​

ReflexFire — at, reflexId, reflexName, source, type, status (fired | skipped | pending | denied | error), detail?, runId?.

RecentEvent — at, source, type, actor?, and matched (how many reflexes matched it). This is the field that answers "did my event arrive but match nothing?".

PendingReflexFire — a fire parked on requireApproval, carrying the full event and a human summary of what will happen if approved.
